title: Handover
description: The dispatch envelope: metadata header of a `dispatch_handover_v1` fenced block. The runtime-layer handover validator enforces the metadata contract.

executor.description: Editing source-of-truth: core/policy/executor-enum.yaml. Keep in sync.

dispatch_route.description: Editing source-of-truth: core/policy/dispatch-routes.yaml. Keep in sync.

brief_file.description: Absolute path; main thread writes via mktemp -p /tmp brief-<slug>-XXXXXX.md mode 0600.

approval.description: Validator rejects values other than `never` for the bash route — see bash-route-approval-never feedback memory.

model.description: PM-facing alias OR wire id OR `default`. Aliases resolved via share/model-aliases.tsv.

skip_git_check.description: Validator hard-rejects true on the bash route — fallback to Agent(codex-executor) for that case.

snapshot_file.description: Optional. Path to a PM-generated context snapshot. Agent treats it as authoritative ground truth when present.
